description: In crates/core/src/audit.rs, shutdown() awaits the background task handle but discards the JoinError with .ok() or equivalent, silently ignoring panics in the flush task. If the flush task panicked (e.g. due to a DB error during final flush), the caller never learns that audit events may have been lost. Fix: log the JoinError at warn/error level before returning, so operators can detect silent audit loss on shutdown.
title: audit shutdown: task JoinError silently discarded
